findings.text: Potrzebny jest wielokrotny wysiłek powtarzania wybranej czynności.
findings.why: The study asked every volunteer to carry out the chosen behaviour daily in the same context, and the upstream cost line names daily repetition for several months. The Polish item says only 'wielokrotny wysiłek powtarzania' and never states the daily frequency, in Koszt, W praktyce or Korzyść i dowody. A reader who repeats the habit weekly or irregularly can take the 18-254 day range as applying to them. The frequency condition behind the time range is missing.

evidence.text: to carry out daily in the same context
在同一个场景下每天重复同一个动作，持续几个月

findings.fix_direction: State in the item that participants repeated the chosen behaviour daily in one context, and that the timing range was not measured for rarer repetition. List the change in Zmiany w adaptacji.

findings.text: Obserwuj regularność, zamiast uznawać brak automatyzmu po 21 dniach za porażkę.
findings.why: The abstract reports that missing one opportunity did not materially affect habit formation, and the upstream span tells the reader that a skipped day does not reset progress. The Polish item dropped this and does not list the drop in Zmiany w adaptacji. A reader who misses one day is told to 'observe regularity' but gets no statement that a single miss is harmless, and may read it as failure.

evidence.text: Missing one opportunity to perform the behaviour did not materially affect the habit formation process.
中间漏掉一天，也不会把进度清零

findings.fix_direction: Carry over the single-miss finding with its scope (one missed opportunity, not repeated misses) or record the omission in Zmiany w adaptacji.

findings.text: wybierających prosty nawyk, głównie związany z jedzeniem, piciem lub ruchem
findings.why: The abstract says each volunteer chose an eating, drinking or activity behaviour, so 'głównie' wrongly implies that some chose other kinds of behaviour. The word 'prosty' is not in the stored abstract; it appears only in the upstream note, which is a lead and not evidence.

evidence.text: 96 volunteers chose an eating, drinking or activity behaviour to carry out daily in the same context
做的都是简单动作（比如饭后吃一份水果）

findings.fix_direction: Match the scope word to the source (each participant chose one eating, drinking or activity behaviour) and keep 'prosty' only if the full text confirms it.

findings.text: Stały kontekst jest sposobem organizacji powtórzeń.
findings.why: Every participant carried out the behaviour in one context, so the study cannot show that a stable context helps compared with a changing one. The title and W praktyce present the stable situation as the instruction. The sentence is marked editorial, but Ograniczenia does not say that fixed versus variable context was not compared.

evidence.text: 96 volunteers chose an eating, drinking or activity behaviour to carry out daily in the same context

findings.fix_direction: Add a limitation that the study did not compare a fixed context with a variable one, so the context advice is editorial.
